text_block_list.text: (Ding...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I received a message from my mother.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I never imagined my own daughter
would run in the Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘I pray that you achieve a result
you can be satisfied with.’"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Alles Gute!" ...It means "Do your best!" according to this.
choice_data_list: I want to live up to my mother's expectations.
You want to live up to your mother's expectations, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Expectations...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, it is not a problem.
All races are the same.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Doing what must be done, just like always.
Carrying out my duties... That is all.
choice_data_list: Are you nervous, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It seems a bit different from nervousness.
I'm not quite sure, though...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
I simply must do what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall be on my way.
(Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the Derby.
The cheers feel like the earth itself is rumbling...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...Why? All of a sudden, I'm trembling...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Nervousness? Anxiety?
No, this is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(This feeling is——
similar to when CB-san passed me.)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The secret to winning the Derby, you see...
is believing that you will win.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fuel the engine with my sheer obsession to win!
I'll swallow up the cheers, my rivals, my limits, and even luck itself!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (...I want to... win.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win... I want to win...
I want to win... I want to win...)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose, no matter what...
The one who becomes the Derby Umamusume will be me...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, everyone!
Give it everything you've got!!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's expectations, excitement, anxiety, fighting spirit...
It's transmitting so strongly it makes me shiver.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (It's trying to swallow everything whole.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I see.
This isn't nervousness. This isn't anxiety.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(This is exhilaration.
Right now, I want to win...!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I have made my decision.
All I seek is Sieg――victory."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: toi,toi,toi――

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The one who should become the Derby Umamusume is...
No, the one who WILL is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's me!
